import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and aggregate revenue by month and region.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
monthly = df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
pivot = monthly.pivot(index='month', columns='region', values='revenue')
months = pivot.index.tolist()
x = range(len(months))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
# Draw EU first, then US at the same positions so US appears in front.
ax.bar(x, pivot['EU'], label='EU', color='tab:orange', zorder=1)
ax.bar(x, pivot['US'], label='US', color='tab:blue', zorder=2)
ax.set_xticks(list(x), months)
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax.set_title('Monthly Revenue: US and EU')
ax.legend()
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
